topics.purpose: Define each remote DWH sharing policy/scope as an explicit identity bound to exact source instance/schema/resources and permitted remote projection semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant remote sharing scope/profile has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.source_rule: Scope binds to exact local/origin instance, schema and resource identities.
semantics.peer_rule: Applicable remote peer/identity/group binding is explicit where policy is peer-specific.
semantics.direction_rule: Read/export/write-delegation directions are explicit and independent.
semantics.schema_rule: Exposed data is constrained by resolved schema/field governance.
semantics.transport_rule: Transport endpoint/address is a binding only and never the sharing-policy identity.
semantics.ownership_rule: Remote sharing does not transfer semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Scope existence does not grant access until normal governance succeeds.

invariants.rule: Remote DWH sharing exposes only explicitly scoped and schema-governed data; transport reachability, endpoint registration, local authorization or broader local ownership never silently expands delegated remote rights.
